title: Can internship experiences bridge the gap between university training and work readiness? Evidence from Vietnamese economics students
core_idea: Investigate how business internship experiences influence work readiness of Vietnamese economics students, using the knowledge–skills–abilities (KSA) framework and self-determination theory (SDT) to test whether professional skills and work motivation mediate the relationship; empirical data come from a structured survey of 389 final-year students analyzed with structural equation modeling.
tldr: Examines whether internships affect economics students' readiness for work in Vietnam by testing mediating roles of professional skills and work motivation under KSA and SDT, using a survey of 389 final-year students and SEM analysis.
